summary: Monthly payrun blocked: duplicate vendor records across subsidiaries causing beneficiary validation failure
description:
Issue summary:
During the scheduled monthly payrun on 2026-03-10, the outbound payment batch (BATCH-2026-03-10-07) failed validation at the bank gateway due to beneficiary account mismatches. The AP system marked the batch as BLOCKED and prevented treasury from executing disbursements.

Impact:
- 42 vendor invoices (combined across two subsidiaries) are in blocked state; estimated disbursement value $142,800.
- Critical vendor SLA exposures for managed services and data center invoices scheduled for 2026-03-12.
- Internal operations: manual intervention required, delaying month-end close activities.

Environment:
- Production AP system (vendor-mgmt v3.8.1) integrated with Treasury Gateway (ext-bank-gw).
- Payrun initiated from Finance Console (us-east region).

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) Payrun scheduled and validation step ran at 07:12 UTC.
2) Bank gateway returned beneficiary validation error code 409-BEN-MIS (account name vs vendor name mismatch) for multiple lines.
3) AP batch validation failed and batch moved to BLOCKED state with hold code: beneficiary_mismatch_cross_sub.
4) On investigation, two vendor records referenced in the batch appear to share the same tax identifier but different bank accounts and subsidiary assignment.

Logs / evidence:
- AP validation log excerpt (2026-03-10 07:12 UTC): "batch BATCH-2026-03-10-07: validation failed - beneficiary_mismatch_cross_sub - vendors: VND-11932,VND-7741"
- Vendor master audit: recent bulk import job job-import-2026-03-09-22 created VND-11932 and VND-7741 with identical tax_id GB999123456 (see import CSV row 122/123).
- Slack thread: #finance-ops thread ts: 2026-03-10 08:05 (link: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C0123456/p1678548300000123)

Investigation notes:
- Hypothesis: bulk vendor import on 2026-03-09 incorrectly created two distinct vendor records for different subsidiaries but with the same tax_id. Downstream normalization logic in the AP pipeline expects unique tax_id per vendor across the consolidated ledger and attempted to coalesce/sanitize leading to inconsistent beneficiary mapping.
- Verified import CSV contained duplicated tax_id but distinct bank_account and subsidiary columns. The vendor-mgmt import tool applied an "auto-create" rule because vendor number field was blank, resulting in two active vendors instead of a cross-reference.
- Engineering ownership: import tool PR that changed auto-create behavior merged 2026-03-08 (related PR: #876). Finance Ops flagged that PR in a weekly review but no rollback was performed.
- Treasury gateway rejects batches where a consolidated tax_id maps to multiple bank accounts without an explicit subsidiary mapping flag. The subsidiary flag is missing in three of the affected vendor master records.

Immediate mitigation taken:
- Finance Ops placed manual hold on batch and extracted CSV to identify all affected invoice lines.
- Temporary remediation: applied a manual mapping override for VND-11932 in the AP console to align subsidiary metadata so the validation passes for priority vendor invoices (7 invoices; total $18,900). This allowed partial unblocking for time-sensitive suppliers.

Proposed next steps / remediation plan:
1) Finance Ops / Vendor Data to reconcile duplicate vendor records: determine canonical vendor per tax_id and subsidiary. (Owner: Vendor Data team)
2) Engineering to add stricter validation to bulk-import job to reject duplicate tax_id across rows unless explicit "cross_subsidiary" flag present. (Owner: Eng - Vendor Import)
3) Update AP normalization logic to require subsidiary scoping when coalescing vendor records and add an error path that surfaces the conflict earlier in the payrun validation UI. (Owner: Eng - AP Service)
4) Treasury to prepare an ad-hoc release process for fully validated manual overrides and record remediation steps for audit. (Owner: Treasury)
5) Postmortem and runbook update: add checklist to Finance runbook for validating bulk vendor imports prior to month-end payruns. (Owner: Finance Ops / Docs)

Risk / compliance notes:
- Any manual mapping overrides will be logged and require dual sign-off from Finance Ops and Treasury for audit trail.
- Potential tax reporting implications if vendor IDs are merged incorrectly. Tax/compliance team notified.

Attachments / links:
- Import job log: s3://redwood-ops/imports/job-import-2026-03-09-22/log.txt
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C0123456/p1678548300000123
- Related pull request: https://github.com/redwood-inference/vendor-importer/pull/876
- Runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/FIN/Payrun+Validation+Runbook
comments: 2026-03-10 08:20 - Carlos Rivera (Finance Ops): Confirmed block. Extracted batch CSV and identified 42 lines tied to the two vendor IDs. Temporarily overrode 7 priority invoices after Treasury sign-off. Will not release remaining blocked lines until vendor master reconciliation.

2026-03-10 10:05 - Priya Singh (Engineering): Triage note - PR #876 changed import behavior. I've retried the import in staging with duplicate tax_id rows and the importer currently creates separate vendors when vendor_number is blank. We should revert auto-create until validation is added. Linking engineering ticket INT-45245 to implement a reject path.

2026-03-11 09:30 - Hannah Lowe (Treasury): Reviewed manual overrides and approved partial release for 7 invoices. Treasury requests a clear audit entry for each override. Will wait on Vendor Data reconciliation before broader release.

2026-03-11 16:12 - Akash Rao (Vendor Data): Starting reconciliation: flagged VND-11932 as canonical for Redwood EU Ltd and VND-7741 flagged for deletion/merge. Need confirmation on historic invoices that should move. ETA for reconciliation: 2026-03-13.

2026-03-12 11:45 - Maya Chen (Reporter): Noted that month-end close is impacted; please prioritize the reconciliation and importer fix. If engineering needs a rollback for PR #876, Finance Ops supports that for immediate mitigation.
resolution: Partial workaround applied; full reconciliation and importer validation pending
resolution_note: Manual overrides allowed for 7 priority invoices after Treasury sign-off. Vendor Data to reconcile duplicate records and Engineering to add validation rules to the importer (see INT-45245). Treasury to release remaining blocked payments after reconciliation and audit entries.
